name: Tsuzuki Denki Co., Ltd.
summary: Tsuzuki Denki Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, construction, and maintenance of network and information systems. The company offers TOTAL SOLUTION SERVICE FRAMEWORK (TSF), IntrameriT, TCloud for Voice, CT-e1/SaaS, CT-e1/SaaS for service cloud voice, TCloud for SCM, TCloud for Smart Produce, D-VUE Service, IoT Solution, TAndd Service, TCloud for BizChat, and Cybersecurity management Support Services, as well as RPA solutions. It serves real estate and construction, medical care and welfare, retail, amusement, manufacturing, fruit and vegetable market, paint sales, government agencies and local authorities, and logistics industries.
